subject: general
question: Kamal can complete a work in 14 days. Vimal is 40% more efficient than Kamal. The number of days Vimal will take to complete the same piece of work is:
solution:
**Given:**

Kamal can complete a work in 14 days.

Vimal is 40% more efficient than Kamal.

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency ∝ 1/Time

If EfficiencyVᵢₘₐₗ = 1.4 × EfficiencyKₐₘₐₗ, then TimeVᵢₘₐₗ = TimeKₐₘₐₗ / 1.4

**Calculation:**

Time taken by Kamal = 14 days

Vimal's efficiency = 1.4 × Kamal's efficiency

Time taken by Vimal = 14 / 1.4

⇒ Time taken by Vimal = 14 / 1.4

⇒ Time taken by Vimal = 10 days

**The number of days Vimal will take to complete the same piece of work is 10 days.**
